rationale: The order authorized the Treasury Secretary to organize the Federal Facilities Corporation, amended Executive Order 9942, designated that corporation to perform the Reconstruction Finance Corporation's rubber, tin and abaca functions, and assigned abaca functions to the General Services Administration. Executive Order 11051 of September 27, 1962, section 604, lists Executive Order 10539 among the orders superseded and revoked, to the extent not already made or inapplicable, and without prejudice to final liquidation of affairs thereunder. The qualifier can only reduce what was left to revoke, and the reservation protects liquidation of affairs, not any continuing command of this order; the order's commands were one-time organization and designation acts and function assignments to bodies that the superseding order and the later reorganizations replaced. The order therefore had no force on 2026-10-14. The two history observations (an Office of the Federal Register API disposition note and a 1989 Office of the Federal Register table entry) are editorial leads that give only an upper bound of 1989-01-20; I did not rely on them and instead read the later order's own text. This is a status judgment on the order's terms and the held text of Executive Order 11051; the first-end dates of the individual clauses are a separate lifecycle question that I have blocked.
